How to Apply
Start your international student application below. You can save your progress at any time and resume later. We will send you a confirmation email after receiving your completed application. Please contact us if you have questions.
Before you begin, you will need the following documents:
A bachelor’s degree in a related field and any postsecondary transcripts
Test scores for any specific standardized tests
Copy of your passport
English-language test scores
*Acceptable English-language tests include TOEFL and IELTS.
